title: Scope Creep / Out-of-Bounds Use
guidance_hint: Define enforced domain boundaries, role gating, and explicit out-of-scope refusals rather than relying on user discipline.

title: Prototype-to-Production Bleed
guidance_hint: Prevent experimental prompts, mock credentials, or unvalidated prototype workflows from entering production paths.

title: Unauthorized Data Leakage / Cross-Tenant Exposure
guidance_hint: Enforce tenant/RBAC filtering before retrieval and redact sensitive data before prompts or logs leave the boundary.

title: Unlawful Processing or Incomplete Deletion
guidance_hint: Verify lawful basis, minimisation, and propagation of retention/deletion across caches, indexes, and logs.

title: IP / Licensing Infringement or Ownership Conflict
guidance_hint: Check corpus licensing, customer ownership commitments, and output attribution/reuse restrictions.

title: Fabrication / Unsupported Consequential Output
guidance_hint: Require grounding citations, abstention thresholds, or deterministic verification before outputs inform consequential steps.

title: Prompt Injection / Untrusted Instruction Hijack
guidance_hint: Treat retrieved/user text as untrusted data; separate system instructions from data and enforce deterministic output/tool constraints.

title: Unauthorized Tool Execution / Runaway Write Action
guidance_hint: Constrain tool permissions to least privilege, validate arguments deterministically, and gate state-changing writes.

title: Fail-Open Under Component or Control Failure
guidance_hint: Specify fail-closed or safe degraded behavior when guardrails, filters, or upstream dependencies time out or error.

title: Vendor / Third-Party Contract & Data-Boundary Breach
guidance_hint: Ensure third-party model endpoints, retention settings, zero-data-retention terms, and regional processing match commitments.

title: Rubber-Stamp Oversight / Automation Bias
guidance_hint: Design human review with meaningful evidence, override authority, time to inspect, and monitoring against blind acceptance.

title: Disparate Harm / Unfair Outcomes on Affected People
guidance_hint: Assess subgroup error/disparity risks and test representative cohorts rather than assuming uniform accuracy.

title: Opaque Output & Lack of Practical Recourse
guidance_hint: Provide intelligible rationale and an accessible human escalation/correction channel for affected parties.

title: Unreconstructable Decisions / Opaque Execution
guidance_hint: Log decision inputs, model/prompt versions, policy checks, and human overrides cleanly without leaking restricted payloads.

title: Silent Supply-Chain Drift & Unmonitored Degradation
guidance_hint: Pin versions or monitor model, prompt, index, and dependency drift with regression thresholds and alert triggers.
